tha-ap91:1.1: Bodhisaññaka.] Vipassissa bhagavato mahābodhimaho ahū / pabbajj' upagato santo upagacchiṃ mahaṃ ahaṃ. // // Kusumodakaṃ
tha-ap91:2.1: ādāya bodhiyā okirim ahaṃ / *mocayissati no mu*tto nibbāpessati nibbuto. // //
tha-ap91:3.1: Ekanavut' ito kappe yaṃ bodhim abhisiñc' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bodhisaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap91:4.1: Tettiṃse vattamānamhi kappe āsuṃ janādhipa / Udakāsecanā nāma aṭṭh' ete cakkavattino. // //
tha-ap91:5.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍābhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap91:6.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Bodhisaññakothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
